title: library schema
description: A physical piece samples are taken on, e.g. a combinatorial thin-film library on a wafer: the sample set that every set measured on the piece belongs to. Sample positions are given in its frame.

physicalId.description: Identifier written on the physical piece

metadata.description: Free-form until formalized: the frame sample positions are given in, the layout of sites on the piece, its dimensions and its synthesis record
